page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core. There is no bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware on this instance type.

Operating with dedicated CPU allocation and a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, the ecs.c2.medium is designed to provide consistent compute performance without the resource contention associated with hyperthreaded environments. The low memory-to-CPU ratio makes this instance a highly specialized hardware profile. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this configuration minimizes memory overhead expenses, making it suitable for workloads that require significant raw integer or floating-point processing power but have minimal memory footprints.

Due to the lack of local storage and the 16 GB memory limit, workloads must rely on network-attached storage. The instance is suited for compute-heavy tasks such as batch processing, distributed analytics worker nodes, high-performance computing tasks with low memory requirements, and CPU-bound microservices.
